summary: PSB Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing closure of its subscription offering in connection with the mutual-to-stock conversion of its subsidiary, Pioneer State Bank. The company sold 1,719,250 shares at $10.00/share for gross proceeds of $17.2M, including ESOP purchases. Common stock is expected to begin trading on OTCQB under ticker PNSB on May 22, 2026. The offering was oversubscribed in the first category by eligible account holders and was allocated according to the plan of conversion. This is a routine capital formation event, not a special situation; no special-situation attributes present.
